# DS-05: Probability and Statistics (Tier 2)

**Subtrack:** Data Science  
**Unit scope:** Distributions, simulation, estimation, sampling, the bootstrap and Bayesian reasoning.

Pick **any one**. Every assessment here is an independent, complete demonstration of this unit at this tier.

| [`DS-T2-009`](DS-T2-009-small-schools-big-swings/README.md) | Small Schools, Big Swings: Empirical Bayes for School Pass Rates | Comparative | education, public-sector, small-area-estimation | 20–35 h | CPU, offline-capable | T3 M4 R2 E3 A3 R1 |
| [`DS-T2-010`](DS-T2-010-the-25-year-storm/README.md) | The 25-Year Storm: Extreme Value Analysis of Rainfall for Drainage Design | Investigation | climate, urban-infrastructure, hydrology | 20–35 h | CPU, offline-capable | T3 M4 R3 E2 A4 R1 |

- **[DS-T2-009](DS-T2-009-small-schools-big-swings/README.md): Small Schools, Big Swings: Empirical Bayes for School Pass Rates.** Build and compare shrinkage estimators of 600 schools' pass rates when cohorts range from 2 to 250, design an evaluation against noisy held-out data, and choose award and intervention lists that reward excellence rather than luck.
- **[DS-T2-010](DS-T2-010-the-25-year-storm/README.md): The 25-Year Storm: Extreme Value Analysis of Rainfall for Drainage Design.** Estimate 25- and 100-year one-day rainfall for culvert design from a 44-year gauge record with outages and clustered storms, using GEV and peaks-over-threshold models with calibrated uncertainty, and decide what a weakly detectable trend means for a 40-year design life.
